about: Atlanta Gas Light's large pipeline (system reinforcement) and LNG projects, as AGL describes them in its 2025-2034 Integrated Capacity and Delivery Plan at the Georgia Public Service Commission (docket 43820). Counties are listed only where AGL's public filing names them. Costs per project are redacted in the public filing and are left out. Read by hand from the filings below; check them before quoting.
